package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb"
	"github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb/celltest"
	"github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb/runtime/remote"
	"github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb/runtime/sqlite"
)

type request struct {
	Mode, URL, Path, Operation string
	Key                        jobdb.JobKey
	Denied                     bool
	Expected                   []byte
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func main() {
	var q request
	must(json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&q))
	ctx := celltest.Context(context.Background())
	if q.Mode == "create" || q.Mode == "reopen" {
		r, err := sqlite.NewFromConfig(ctx, sqlite.Config{DBPath: q.Path, MaxInlineArtifactBytes: 1})
		must(err)
		if q.Mode == "create" {
			_, err = r.CreateCell(ctx, jobdb.CreateCellRequest{TenantID: "tenant", Name: "compat", Repo: "example.test/compat"})
			must(err)
			h, err := r.SubmitJob(ctx, jobdb.SubmitJobRequest{Job: jobdb.SubmitJob{TenantId: "tenant", Cell: "compat", JobType: "read", Data: jobdb.NewTaskDataOrPanic("baseline", jobdb.NewArtifactFromBytes("same.bin", q.Expected))}})
			must(err)
			q.Key = h.JobKey
			lease, err := r.GetJobLease(ctx, jobdb.GetJobLeaseRequest{JobKey: h.JobKey, WorkerID: "baseline", Routes: []jobdb.Route{{JobType: "read"}}, LeaseDuration: time.Minute})
			must(err)
			if lease == nil {
				panic("missing baseline lease")
			}
			chapter := jobdb.Chapter{Ordinal: 1, TaskType: "read", CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Body: jobdb.JobAttemptOutcomeChapter{Outcome: jobdb.ApplicationOutputOutcome{Output: jobdb.ApplicationOutputBytes{Data: []byte(`"retained-result"`)}}}}
			must(lease.Complete(ctx, jobdb.CompleteExecutionRequest{Status: "success", Chapter: &chapter}))
		}
		info, err := r.GetJob(ctx, q.Key)
		must(err)
		if info.Status != jobdb.JobStatusCompleted {
			panic("baseline terminal record changed")
		}
		chapters, err := r.ListChapters(ctx, jobdb.ListChaptersRequest{JobKey: q.Key})
		must(err)
		if len(chapters) != 2 || chapters[0].Ordinal != 0 || chapters[1].Ordinal != 1 {
			panic("baseline chapters changed")
		}
		reader, err := r.OpenArtifact(ctx, jobdb.ArtifactRef{JobKey: q.Key, Ordinal: 0, Name: "same.bin"})
		must(err)
		stream, err := reader.Open()
		must(err)
		b, err := io.ReadAll(stream)
		must(err)
		must(stream.Close())
		if !bytes.Equal(b, q.Expected) {
			panic("baseline artifact changed")
		}
		must(r.Close(ctx))
		must(json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(q.Key))
		return
	}
	client, err := remote.New(q.URL, nil)
	must(err)
	var readErr error
	switch q.Operation {
	case "job":
		info, err := client.GetJob(ctx, q.Key)
		readErr = err
		if err != nil && info.Data != nil {
			panic("denied job returned data")
		}
		if err == nil {
			if info.Status != jobdb.JobStatusCompleted || info.CompletionStatus != "success" {
				panic("baseline client terminal metadata")
			}
			data, err := info.Data.GetData()
			must(err)
			b, err := json.Marshal(data)
			must(err)
			if string(b) != `"retained-result"` {
				panic("baseline client payload changed")
			}
		}
	case "list":
		chapters, err := client.ListChapters(ctx, jobdb.ListChaptersRequest{JobKey: q.Key})
		readErr = err
		if err == nil && (len(chapters) != 2 || chapters[0].Ordinal != 0 || chapters[1].Ordinal != 1 || len(chapters[0].Artifacts) != 1) {
			panic("baseline client chapter list")
		}
		if err != nil && len(chapters) != 0 {
			panic("denied list returned data")
		}
		if err == nil {
			body, ok := chapters[0].Body.(jobdb.JobStartChapter)
			if !ok || string(body.Input.Data) != `"input"` {
				panic("baseline client list payload")
			}
		}
	case "chapter":
		chapter, err := client.GetChapter(ctx, jobdb.ChapterRef{JobKey: q.Key, Ordinal: 0})
		readErr = err
		if err != nil && (chapter.Body != nil || len(chapter.Artifacts) != 0) {
			panic("denied chapter returned data")
		}
		if err == nil && (chapter.Ordinal != 0 || len(chapter.Artifacts) != 1) {
			panic("baseline client chapter")
		}
		if err == nil {
			body, ok := chapter.Body.(jobdb.JobStartChapter)
			if !ok || string(body.Input.Data) != `"input"` {
				panic("baseline client chapter payload")
			}
		}
	case "artifact", "open":
		reader, err := client.OpenArtifact(ctx, jobdb.ArtifactRef{JobKey: q.Key, Ordinal: 0, Name: "same.bin"})
		readErr = err
		if err == nil {
			stream, err := reader.Open()
			must(err)
			b, err := io.ReadAll(stream)
			must(err)
			must(stream.Close())
			if !bytes.Equal(b, q.Expected) || reader.Name() != "same.bin" || reader.Size() != int64(len(q.Expected)) {
				panic("baseline client wrong producer artifact")
			}
		} else if reader != nil {
			panic("denied artifact returned reader")
		}
	default:
		panic("unknown operation")
	}
	if q.Denied {
		if !errors.Is(readErr, jobdb.ErrLeasePermissionDenied) || errors.Is(readErr, jobdb.ErrExecutionLeaseLost) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("baseline client denial: %v", readErr))
		}
	} else {
		must(readErr)
	}
	fmt.Println("baseline client behavior passed")
}
